caption: Kar. 80. Altar
notes: Two chipped areas drawn as outlines without hatching (in line 3 after l?, and a long one in line 5 between o and r); I wrote no [.] for them since the copy shows no hatching. V read as b (plain V, no hook). Line 4: 'as?to' could be 'ato' with an extra 3-shaped sign (s/m/h); 'te' is /-4-bar. Line 5: first sign a flat-topped 3 with tail (k or h), second a crossed hooked sign (d or ñ). Line 3 'ñ?' is hatched. Number of lost signs in hatched stretches estimated from width.

notes: Line 1: s of wos?i hatched. 'tq?': dot-ϟ then /3 (q or o+s). 'qowi' read from //ɔ (ɔ with a dot). Line 3 'popoyol': ε-topped long-tailed signs read p (could be k). Line 4: after te the d is ʎ-shaped, the sign marked sic looks like e (ḫ expected). Start of row 3 hatched about 2 signs; 'y' there is four strokes. Line 5 'terkelo': no i drawn between r and k; r written ᴄω. Line 7-8: hatching after te then an S; S plus hatching may be a with its tail lost. Line 9 end: a 3 and three short strokes (y?). Line 11 'ḫmlol' uncertain (ϟ forms read l). Lines 13-14 repeat the invocation at the end of the altar text.
